# Daily Briefing – Tuesday 20 October

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training logged and just 4,699 steps, well below an active baseline. Your calorie burn of 2,364 kcal essentially matched your 2,300 target, which is fine on a rest day, but keep an eye on protein intake since low-movement days make it easy to drift under your 175g goal.

Your recovery picture is mixed. HRV at 93ms sits below your 99–121ms baseline, suggesting your body is asking for respect today rather than a hard effort. The flip side — resting HR of 52bpm and stress at 36/100 — is genuinely encouraging, so you're not run down, just not fully primed.

Today's tip: prioritise protein at breakfast. Hitting 40–50g early (think eggs plus Greek yoghurt) makes reaching 175g far easier and supports the body composition progress towards your 80–85kg target.
